findings.why: A new freshness SLA rule on the 5-minute windowed averages so the on-call engineer is alerted when the live map goes stale; the feature promises a 5-minute refresh and nothing else tells anyone when it stops.

Declare the dispatch database as a new source with a freshness threshold and add not_null/unique tests on the new driver scorecard model, otherwise a stalled nightly CDC produces an empty scorecard silently.
The why says the report hosts the restated figures finance views; the daily revenue report reads the rebuilt gold table unchanged, so the feature uses the dashboard rather than changing it.
